title: archkeel validate — From source files to an exit code

story.title: archkeel validate — From source files to an exit code

steps.title: Enter Validate
steps.note: The command parser routes validation to the decision path.

steps.title: Select the configuration
steps.note: Resolve the project root and configuration. Locate the core before any first-run draft can write files.

steps.title: Start the scan
steps.note: Scan with the selected configuration after the draft check.

steps.title: Bind the scan request
steps.note: Serialize the request and confirm the core binary immediately before invoking it.

steps.title: Send the request
steps.note: Pass the scan request to the child process on standard input.

steps.title: Read the request
steps.note: The core reads a bounded scan request. The snapshot does not record the process target or Rust calls.

steps.title: Dispatch the scan
steps.note: The scan entry calls the scan handler.

steps.title: Decode the request
steps.note: Decode the protocol fields before choosing the run.

steps.title: Choose a scan
steps.note: An individual scan uses one configuration. A system document follows its separate system path.

steps.title: Collect the configured scope
steps.note: Run the collector and pass a completed collection to evaluation.

steps.title: Bind facts to the contract
steps.note: Bind the reply to the scanned roots and provenance before evaluating the contract.

steps.title: Build the ruling
steps.note: Combine rule decisions and coverage gaps in one frame. A gap can leave a rule UNKNOWN.

steps.title: Return the ruling
steps.note: The Rust result returns through the scan path. The snapshot does not observe runtime returns.

steps.title: Receive the frame
steps.note: Capture the child process output and exit status. The transport is a process boundary.

steps.title: Return to the shell
steps.note: Hand the captured bytes and exit status to the wrapper.

steps.title: Check the frame
steps.note: Check its protocol, verdict and request binding before delivery.

steps.title: Return the checked frame
steps.note: Return the checked frame to the scan wrapper.

steps.title: Finish validation
steps.note: Build the CLI result from the frame, including gaps and outcomes.

steps.title: Set the exit status
steps.note: A normal validation returns 0 for PASS, 1 for FAIL or 2 for UNKNOWN. JSON also names command or collection refusals.
